sources.title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
sources.snippet: This work introduces Gemma, a family of lightweight, state-of-the art open models built from the research and technology used to create Gemini models. Gemma models demonstrate strong performance across academic benchmarks for language understanding, reasoning, and safety.
